Messages.Author: lizardusrex
Messages.Body:
If I play Dawn Operation when blocked and then Conscripted Statue will
the "all damage inflicted to all vampires in the resulting combat is
aggravated" still be valid in the the combat with the statue?

Can the opponent play prevent cards if i striked with Withering?

Thanks

JK

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <882ee023.01123...@posting.google.com>,

lizardusrex <lizard...@hotmail.com> writes:
>If I play Dawn Operation when blocked and then Conscripted Statue will
>the "all damage inflicted to all vampires in the resulting combat is
>aggravated" still be valid in the the combat with the statue?

No. That combat isn't the "resulting" combat.

>Can the opponent play prevent cards if i striked with Withering?

If he has any prevent cards that are disciplineless, sure.

But things like Skin of Rock etc. aren't playable because the strike has
resolved - though damage is still being handled.
